slug: 2026-07-15 CSquared boosts internet by integrating with 2Africa West cable

facts.fact: Mobile Europe (15 Jul 2026) reports that CSquared's existing West Africa architecture includes the Equiano cable landing in Nigeria/Togo and reaching Benin (with Ghana and Burkina Faso) via terrestrial backbone.

note: 2Africa West capacity added to CSquared's network is not stated to reach BEN, so it is not a BEN fact.
